subject.title: Android: Add message copy and text selection to chat screen

question: Should Android chat add a narrow Copy/Select Copy message action surface first, or adopt the broader Copy/Select Copy/Share/Reply long-press sheet proposed by the linked fork PR?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but Share and Reply expand product behavior beyond the core copy/select request and the only open implementation candidate is conflicting.

options.title: Approve copy-first Android message actions
options.body: Land Copy and Select Copy for normal chat messages first, with Share and Reply left for a follow-up unless maintainers explicitly sponsor them.

options.title: Adopt the full linked fork scope
options.body: Refresh and review the linked fork PR's full four-action bottom sheet after resolving conflicts and proving the behavior on Android.

options.title: Defer Android message actions
options.body: Keep current code-block-only selection and close or park the linked PR if maintainers do not want this UX surface now.

recommendation.title: Approve copy-first Android message actions
recommendation.body: Land Copy and Select Copy for normal chat messages first, with Share and Reply left for a follow-up unless maintainers explicitly sponsor them.
